purpose: Rollback standard — realistic recovery paths for each destructive action type

license_removal.action: License reassignment via M365 admin center
license_removal.limitations: OneDrive data preserved for 30 days after license removal; Teams data preserved per retention policy

mailbox_change.alias_restoration: Alias can be re-added via Exchange admin center
mailbox_change.forwarding_restoration: Rule can be removed; original behavior restores immediately
mailbox_change.mailbox_retirement: Soft-deleted mailbox recoverable for 30 days in Exchange Online; after 30 days, permanent

teams_group_archive.teams_unarchive: Teams archive is reversible — unarchive via Teams admin center
teams_group_archive.group_soft_delete: M365 Group soft-deleted — recoverable for 30 days
teams_group_archive.sharepoint_read_only: SharePoint read-only is fully reversible; no data loss

sharepoint_content_deletion.recycle_bin: SharePoint first-stage recycle bin retains items for 93 days; second-stage recycle bin extends further
sharepoint_content_deletion.migration_destination: foundation_div (destination for foundation_comm content) retains migrated content independent of source deletion
sharepoint_content_deletion.archive_zip: sites/projects dev artifact ZIP is the rollback for SharePoint deletion of build artifacts

app_registration_retirement.soft_delete: Entra ID app registrations are soft-deleted — recoverable within 30 days
app_registration_retirement.federated_credentials: OIDC federated credentials can be re-added; GitHub Actions re-authenticates on next run
app_registration_retirement.important: Service principal permission grants (Azure RBAC, Dataverse roles) must be reassigned after recovery — document before retirement

repository_archive.github_archive: GitHub archive is fully reversible — unarchive via repo settings
repository_archive.permanent_delete: NEVER delete remote repos. Archive only.
